kaladhautaśilāvṛkṣatṛṇagulmalatādiṣviva mayā
svaśarīrāvayaveṣvapyavahitadṛśā sargā dṛṣṭā ityāha - tata iti

ākāravati mūrte anākāre amūrte cittvācittve cetanācetane sarvavastuni
antaḥsekādūrdhvamucchūne bīje'ṅkura iva jagadastīti śeṣaḥ
vigate vā svapne bodhameyuṣo jāgratprapañca unmiṣati tathaivetyagre'nvayaḥ

hṛdi sargodaya iti tvayā hṛtpadena hṛdayākāśa uktaḥ ākāśarūpata iti ca cidākāśa
iti mayā tvadabhiprāyo'vagata iti saṃbodhanena sūcayan rāmaḥ sphuṭaparijñānāya
vistarātpunaḥ kathayeti prārthayate - ākāśeti

hṛdayākāśa paramākāśarūpa he
vasiṣṭha cidākāśarūpe tvayi kathaṃ sargaḥ pravartate tatpunaḥ kathyatāmityarthaḥ

taṃ prāgvistarādvarṇitaṃ kaladhautaśilādau mahākalpasaṃbhramamālokya
cidvyomarūpiṇā mayā śarīrasyānyatra bhāge sthitā saṃvit sargadarśanasaṃkalpena
kautukādunmeṣitetyarthaḥ

tatrādau tasmādvā etasmādātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ iti
śrutyuktakramopalakṣaṇamākāśakalpanamāha - yadaiveti

iyaṃ cākāśatā na cidghanasyāntaḥśūnyabhāvaprāptilakṣaṇasaukṣmyādhikyaṃ kiṃtu
citsaukṣmyāpekṣayā jāḍyādhikyātsthaulyamevetyāśayena dṛṣṭāntena saṃbhāvayati
- gatamiti

he rāma yathā tvaṃ nidrayā prāgvarṇitasvapnajāgrallokaṃ vā svapnaṃ
svapnalokaṃ vā viśan svātmana eva samaṃ ghanaṃ tadādhārasvabhāvaṃ vetsi
tadvatsaṃbhāvayetyarthaḥ

diśo mimīte svacalanānukūlatayā svātmani paryālocayatīti diṅmātraṃ
tathāvidhamākāśamevādau cetanāccittaṃ bhavati

tadvaśādeva prāṅnirduḥkhasyātmanaḥ svapna iva vyavahāraduḥkhāvāptirityāha -
suṣuptāditi

nanu svapne nākāśādikrameṇa sargaḥ kiṃtu tulyakālameva sahasā sarvajagaddarśanamiti
vaiṣamyaṃ tatrāha - tulyakāleti
sa aikṣata lokānnu sṛjā iti sa imāṁllokānasṛjata

sa tapastaptvā idaṃ sarvamasṛjata ityādiśrutiṣu tulyakālamapi sargaśravaṇāt
kṣaṇodare'pi kāladairghyakalpanena kramopapatteriti bhāvaḥ

kṣaṇodare kāladairghyamiva paramāṇūdare'pi deśadairghyakalpanayā tatra
brahmāṇḍātmakaṃ cetanamātmānamahameva kalpanayā dṛṣṭavānityāha -
paramāṇviti
marutaścalanamiva manasaḥ śarīrādikalpanaṃ svabhāva ityāha - yatheti

tayā prāthamikamanaḥkalpanāśaktyā eṣā śaktiḥ svayamapyanyathākartuṃ na
śaknotītyuttarakalpanāsu saiva sthirā niyatirityarthaḥ

ata evāhamaparicchinno'pi tatkṛtaparicchedakalpanayā aṇurūpakaḥ paricchinnaḥ
saṃpanna ityāha - tata iti

tatra cakṣurādidvārakalpanayā rūpādidraṣṭṛtā svasya saṃpannetyāha - prekṣe
ityādinā
tadanu niṣpādinī nāntarīyakī deśakālādiniyatirapi saṃpannetyāha - yadeti

iti uktarītyā vedini mayi sparśanendriyatanmātraṃ saṃsthitaṃ saṃpannamiti
pūrvānuvādaḥ

ghrāṇaṃ ca
tadviṣayagandhatanmātrā ca tayoḥ samāhāro ghrāṇatanmātram
tato balādeva pañcabhogasaṃvida uditā ityāha - evamiti

vidaḥ
śabdādiprathālakṣaṇā bhogasaṃvido mithyātvādeva anākārā bhrāntimātreṇa tathā
bhātasvarūpiṇyaḥ

yato'haṃ śūnyākṛtirata eva sarveṣāmeva kalpyamānabhāvānāmarodhakaḥ
anirodhako'nivārakaśca

tatra tasminpūrvakalpite brahmātmakadehe ciraṃ yadā sthitastadā tadantaḥ ahaṃ svenaiva
caturmukhadehavāndṛṣṭaḥ

tena tādṛśadehapratyayena svapne uḍḍīno nabhasi saṃcarannaro yathā ravaṃ karoti tathā
śabdaṃ kartuṃ pravṛttavān

tatra viśeṣābhilāpe vinigamakābhāvātsarvasādhāraṇārthakaḥ śabdasamaṣṭyātmā
oṃkāra eva prathamamuccārita ityāha - atheti
ayameva nyāyaḥ sarvasargeṣu bodhya ityāśayenāha - itthamiti

nṛmanorājyam iti
pāṭhe saṃkalpe sthitasya nuḥ puruṣasya manorājyaṃ yatheti

ata eva prāgādhibhautikadṛśā darśane lokālokagirireva dṛśyate na śilāntargataṃ
brahmāṇḍamityuktamityāha - ādhibhautiketi
sargo dṛśyatesa ca paramātmaiva lakṣyate yogibhirityarthaḥ
tattvadṛṣṭiṃ yogidṛṣṭiṃ ca sarvotkarṣeṇa praśaṃsati - yaditi

tatra svasya tattvajñasya yadā jīvanmuktayogidṛśā paśyata ākāśamiva bhūrapi
sarvataḥ sargairvyāpteti buddhirutpannā tadā
kramādbhūmyādyekaikabhūtāhaṃbhāvadhāraṇayā yadyatkautukaṃ svena dṛṣṭaṃ
tatsarvaṃ vistarādvarṇayiṣyanprathamaṃ dharādhāraṇādṛṣṭaṃ tadvaktumupakramate
- yatheti

yathā samrāṭ cakravartī svadehamātrāhaṃbhāvamatyajanneva samastabhūmaṇḍale
mamatābhāvaṃ dhatte tathā ahamapi cidvyomavapurbrahmāhaṃbhāvamatyajanneva
dharāhaṃbhāvena dharārūpadharo'bhavamityarthaḥ

śobhamānā ibhāstantavaḥ senājālatantugranthaya iva yeṣāṃ tathāvidhairmahīpālaiḥ
parasparaṃ yuddhairhriyamāṇam

pūrvaṃ bhūtairbhūtapūrvairmahārṇavaiḥ pralayakāle parāpūrṇamata eva sāṃprataṃ
snātvodgatamiva paritaḥ pūtaṃ pavitram

bdhaṃ iti
mūlaṭīkayoḥ pāṭhavaiṣamyaṃ sarvādarśeṣu dṛśyate

lokālokasamīpe prāgvarṇito yo mahākhātavalayastallakṣaṇenogreṇāsyena bhīṣaṇam
bhūtānāṃ parispanda eva parispanda ekībhūtaṃ cetanameva cetana yasya
